## Processes

### 1. ` typed `

#### SQL

```sql
SELECT label, amount, active, business_date, event_time, event_at, payload,
       first_flag, last_flag,
       CAST(signed_le AS SMALLINT) AS signed_le,
       CAST(signed_be AS SMALLINT) AS signed_be,
       CAST(unsigned_le AS INT UNSIGNED) AS unsigned_le,
       CAST(unsigned_be AS INT UNSIGNED) AS unsigned_be,
       CAST(ieee_le AS REAL) AS ieee_le,
       CAST(ieee_be AS DOUBLE) AS ieee_be,
       CAST(ibm_le AS DOUBLE) AS ibm_le,
       CAST(ibm_be AS DOUBLE) AS ibm_be,
       trailing_sign, leading_sign, separate_sign, unsigned_zone,
       signed_packed, unsigned_packed, no_sign_packed
FROM records
```
